Name: Cacodemon Pet
Author: Normalman
Description:
Everyone loves Cacodemons, but I'm not sure if you'd want one anywhere near your precious farm. Luckily, this one's been domesticated and only eats your love and affection!  This mod replaces all three of the cats with a custom made cacodemon, along with replacement sounds for when you interact with them.

INSTALLATION - Simply copy/paste the contents of the .zip into your Stardew Valley folder. As always be sure to back up your files beforehand, and if your sound file is already modded in some other way; the XACT folder isn't neccessary. It'll just give you a Caco that meows instead of proper gronking and blubbering.
